english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a pleasurable special treat, or for gratification.
Use this as the everyday noun for a pleasant nonessential comfort or indulgence.
Use this when enjoyment is framed as a pleasurable experience or indulgence.

examples.english: This cup of good coffee is my little indulgence after work.
examples.traditional: 呢杯靚咖啡係我放工後嘅小小享受。
examples.jyutping: nei1 bui1 leng3 gaa3 fe1 hai6 ngo5 fong3 gung1 hau6 ge3 siu2 siu2 hoeng2 sau6

examples.english: Having an iced lemon tea after work is a daily luxury for me.
examples.traditional: 放工飲杯凍檸茶係我每日嘅享受。
examples.jyutping: fong3 gung1 jam2 bui1 dung3 ling4 caa4 hai6 ngo5 mui5 jat6 ge3 hoeng2 sau6

examples.english: I get the most enjoyment from slowly drinking coffee on holiday mornings.
examples.traditional: 我最享受放假朝早慢慢飲咖啡。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 hoeng2 sau6 fong3 gaa3 ziu1 zou2 maan6 maan6 jam2 gaa3 fe1
